notes:
TCC Website 0.12.1: signed-out visitors get the page's own styles again

Divi 5 prints its default styles inside each page. WP Rocket's
"Remove Unused CSS" leaves that block where it is, after its own trimmed
block, so Divi's defaults beat the page's settings in WP Rocket's saved
copies (the home page text was 14px instead of 20px for signed-out
visitors). "No flash of unstyled page" now moves Divi's block back in
front while WP Rocket builds each saved copy. Help tab and AI prompts
updated. After updating: WP Rocket > Clear Used CSS, then Clear and
Preload Cache.
